about.title: About
about.subtitle: Atlas Munich is a community guide built to reduce the friction of arriving in Munich, especially for Moroccan students navigating bureaucracy, housing, and daily life.

story.title: Why We Built This
story.p1: Moving to Munich as a Moroccan student or professional can be overwhelming. The bureaucracy is complex, finding housing is challenging, and figuring out where to find halal food takes time.
story.p2Start: Atlas Munich was born from this experience.
story.p2End: We wanted to create a single, trusted resource that answers all the questions newcomers have, the same questions we once had.
story.p3: Today, Atlas Munich is a growing collection of guides, tips, and resources maintained by volunteers who have been through it all and want to help others do the same.

al-zaeem.name: Al Zaeem
al-zaeem.description: Popular spot near the main station offering a variety of halal Middle Eastern dishes including kebabs and falafel at affordable prices.

tacos-muenchner-freiheit.name: SAVOS (French Tacos)
tacos-muenchner-freiheit.description: Located near Münchner Freiheit, this spot serves delicious tacos and wraps with halal-certified ingredients. Perfect for a quick bite or a casual lunch with friends.

anju-89.name: Anju 89
anju-89.description: A popular student-friendly restaurant close to the Technical University of Munich (TUM). Anju serves flavorful halal meals, making it a favorite among international students.

taste-my-burger.name: Taste My Burger
taste-my-burger.description: Gourmet burger joint offering a variety of halal burger options with fresh ingredients and unique toppings. A great spot for casual dining with friends.

the-ash-muenchner-freiheit.name: The Ash
the-ash-muenchner-freiheit.description: A stylish restaurant offering premium grilled dishes. They provide halal meat options upon request, making it a great place for dining out with friends or family.

argana-moroccan-restaurant.name: Argana - Moroccan Restaurant
argana-moroccan-restaurant.description: A newly opened Moroccan restaurant in Munich offering authentic Moroccan dishes such as tagines, couscous, and pastilla. Argana is fully halal and beautifully reflects the Moroccan culinary tradition in a cozy setting.

casablanca-moroccan-restaurant.name: Casablanca - Moroccan Restaurant
casablanca-moroccan-restaurant.description: Casablanca offers a rich menu of authentic Moroccan cuisine, including flavorful tagines and couscous dishes. The restaurant is fully halal and provides a warm, inviting atmosphere reminiscent of Morocco.

la-fantasia.name: La Fantasia
la-fantasia.description: Charming Italian restaurant serving a variety of halal pasta and pizza dishes. La Fantasia offers a cozy ambiance perfect for family dinners or romantic evenings.

bln-doener.name: BLN Döner
bln-doener.description: Popular fast-food spot in the city center known for its delicious halal döner kebabs and affordable prices. Perfect for a quick and satisfying meal.

hans-kebap-muenchen.name: Hans Kebap
hans-kebap-muenchen.description: Premium kebab restaurant offering a variety of halal kebab options made with high-quality ingredients. A great choice for those looking for a more upscale fast-food experience.

uncle-smash-burger.name: Uncle Smash Burger
uncle-smash-burger.description: Gourmet burger joint offering a variety of halal burger options with fresh ingredients and unique toppings. A great spot for casual dining with friends.

pars-restaurant.name: Pars Restaurant
pars-restaurant.description: Authentic Persian restaurant offering a variety of halal dishes including kebabs and grilled specialties. A cozy spot for enjoying traditional flavors.

kashgar-uyghur.name: Kashgar Uyghur Restaurant
kashgar-uyghur.description: Specializing in Uyghur cuisine, this halal restaurant offers unique dishes such as hand-pulled noodles and grilled meats. A must-visit for those seeking authentic flavors.

etem-burger-steak.name: Etem Burger & Steak
etem-burger-steak.description: Casual dining spot known for its halal burgers and steaks made from quality ingredients. A great place for a relaxed meal with friends or family.

loco-chicken.name: Loco Chicken
loco-chicken.description: Popular fast-food joint specializing in halal chicken dishes. Known for its crispy fried chicken and affordable prices, making it a favorite among locals.

hot-dog-station-muenchen.name: Hot Dog Station
hot-dog-station-muenchen.description: Casual eatery specializing in halal hot dogs with a variety of toppings. A great spot for a quick and tasty meal on the go.

wing-nation.name: Wing Nation
wing-nation.description: Casual dining spot specializing in halal chicken wings with a variety of sauces and sides. Perfect for a quick bite or casual meal with friends.

han-muenchen.name: Han Restaurant
han-muenchen.description: Turkish restaurant known for its halal grilled dishes, including the famous Adana kebab. A cozy spot for enjoying authentic Turkish flavors.

delicious-burger.name: Delicious Burger
delicious-burger.description: Gourmet burger joint offering a variety of halal burger options with fresh ingredients and unique toppings. A great spot for casual dining with friends.

rasoi-restaurant.name: Rasoi Restaurant
rasoi-restaurant.description: Authentic Indian restaurant offering a variety of halal dishes including flavorful curries and tandoori specialties. A cozy spot for enjoying traditional Indian cuisine.

samarkand-restaurant.name: Samarkand Grill & Burgerhaus
samarkand-restaurant.description: Uzbek restaurant offering a variety of halal grilled dishes and burgers. Samarkand provides an authentic taste of Central Asian cuisine in a welcoming atmosphere.

moosacher-paradies.name: Moosacher Paradies
moosacher-paradies.description: Balkan restaurant specializing in halal grilled dishes and barbecue. Moosacher Paradies offers authentic flavors in a cozy setting, perfect for family dinners or group gatherings.

halal-metzger-giesing.name: Halal Metzger Giesing
halal-metzger-giesing.description: Quality halal meat at reasonable prices. Trusted by the community.

dolphin-market-moosach.name: Dolphin Market
dolphin-market-moosach.description: Located directly at the Moosach U-Bahn station. Known for 'controlled Halal meat from Bavarian breeding' and a separate fresh fish counter, which is rare for local supermarkets.

metzgerei-etem.name: Metzgerei Etem
metzgerei-etem.description: Widely considered the best halal butcher in Munich. Famous for dry-aged steaks, homemade sucuk, and a strict no-pork policy. Located near the Olympiadorf student housing.

verdi-supermarkt-ludwigsvorstadt.name: Verdi Supermarkt & Metzgerei
verdi-supermarkt-ludwigsvorstadt.description: A staple for students living centrally. The butcher counter is massive, offering affordable lamb and beef cuts. Very busy, high turnover ensures freshness.

hahn-fleischhandel.name: Hahn Fleischhandel
hahn-fleischhandel.description: Located directly at the slaughterhouse district (Schlachthof). They sell to restaurants but also have an 'Abholmarkt' for individuals. Certified halal regional meat.

islamisches-zentrum-muenchen.name: Islamisches Zentrum München (IZM)
islamisches-zentrum-muenchen.description: One of the largest mosques in Munich with regular prayers, community events, and educational programs.

masjid-al-mohsinin.name: Masjid Al-Mohsinin
masjid-al-mohsinin.description: Moroccan mosque serving the local community with regular prayers and educational activities.

masjid-al-rahma.name: Masjid Al-Rahma
masjid-al-rahma.description: Active mosque with Quran classes and community events.

marokko-haus.name: Marokko Haus Mosque
marokko-haus.description: Mosque located within the Marokko Haus, serving the Moroccan community in Munich.

alahibba-mosque.name: Alahibba Mosque (Muslimisches Kulturforum München e.V.)
alahibba-mosque.description: A vibrant community hub also known as the Muslim Cultural Forum. It offers bilingual Friday sermons (German/Arabic), Quran classes for all ages, and regular community events.

ditib-sendling.name: DITIB Moschee Sendling
ditib-sendling.description: Turkish mosque with active community programs and weekly gatherings.

tum-library-stammgelaende.name: TUM Main Library
tum-library-stammgelaende.description: Large study library with many seats, good WiFi, and power outlets at most desks.

tum-campus-garching-mi.name: TUM Garching (MI Building)
tum-campus-garching-mi.description: The 'Magistrale' hall inside the Math/Informatics building. Famous for its giant parabolic slides, it offers open study tables and a lively atmosphere.

studitum-muenchen.name: StudiTUM München
studitum-muenchen.description: A dedicated study house exclusively for students. Features quiet rooms, lounge areas, and a roof terrace. Requires valid student ID for access.

bayerische-staatsbibliothek.name: Bayerische Staatsbibliothek
bayerische-staatsbibliothek.description: Magnificent state library with extensive collection and beautiful study spaces.

lmu-philologicum.name: LMU Philologicum
lmu-philologicum.description: Modern LMU library with excellent study environment and natural lighting.

lost-weekend.name: Lost Weekend
lost-weekend.description: The quintessential student cafe near LMU. 100% vegan, laptop-friendly during the day, and hosts events at night.

bibliothek-deutsches-museum.name: Bibliothek des Deutschen Museums
bibliothek-deutsches-museum.description: One of the best reference libraries for science and technology. Extremely quiet atmosphere, perfect for deep focus.

monacensia-hildebrandhaus.name: Monacensia im Hildebrandhaus
monacensia-hildebrandhaus.description: A beautiful artist's villa turned literary archive. Offers a stunning reading room and a quiet garden accessible to the public.

vorhoelzer-forum.name: Vorhoelzer Forum
vorhoelzer-forum.description: Located on the TUM rooftop, this spot offers decent coffee, large tables, and one of the best views over Munich.

mueller-odeonsplatz.name: Müller Café & Bäckerei (Odeonsplatz)
mueller-odeonsplatz.description: Located directly at Odeonsplatz, this is a spacious bakery-cafe. While often busy with tourists and locals, its large upper seating area offers a solid spot for a quick breakfast or coffee between lectures.

mackbear-leopoldstr.name: Mackbear Coffee Co.
mackbear-leopoldstr.description: Often affectionately called 'McBear', this is a top spot for deep work near Münchner Freiheit. Known for very strong coffee, modern interior, and being explicitly laptop-friendly with plenty of power outlets.

cadu-cafe-an-der-uni.name: CADU (Café an der Uni)
cadu-cafe-an-der-uni.description: A legendary institution directly next to the LMU main building (U-Bahn Universität). It transitions from a breakfast spot to a lively bar in the evening. Great for meeting people, less so for silent study.

cafe-zeitgeist.name: Café Zeitgeist
cafe-zeitgeist.description: Similar to CADU but deep in the Türkenstraße student quarter. Extremely popular for its affordable student breakfast/brunch and lively atmosphere. A classic place to meet friends after class.

benko-cafe.name: Benko Café
benko-cafe.description: A favorite for Technical University (TUM) students due to its proximity to the main campus. It offers a spacious interior with large tables, making it good for groups or lunch breaks between seminars.

sections.title: What we process
sections.summary: Every category of data the site touches, why it is processed, on what legal basis and for how long.

blocks.x: You can read every guide, answer and place listing on {entity} without telling us anything about yourself. The categories below are the complete set of data the service handles.
Access and server log data

Each time a page or asset is requested, our hosting provider processes technical connection data: the IP address of the requesting device, date and time, the resource requested, the HTTP status and volume transferred, the referring page, and the browser and operating system identifiers your device sends. This is technically necessary to deliver the page and to keep the service stable and secure. It is not merged with other sources and is not used to identify you.
Usage analytics

We use Vercel Web Analytics and Vercel Speed Insights. Both are cookieless and neither sets nor reads identifiers on your device. They report aggregate figures such as page views, referrer category, country level region, device type and page loading performance. A short lived, non-reversible hash derived from request properties is used only to separate one visit from another, and we cannot trace it back to a person.
AI assistant conversations

If you open one of the assistants, the messages you type, the assistant you selected, your interface language and the path of the page you were on are transmitted to our AI processor so that a reply can be generated. Conversations are not written to any database of ours and are not linked to a profile. The technical detail is in section 6.
Abuse prevention

To stop a single client from overwhelming the assistant endpoint, the IP address supplied by our hosting proxy is held in volatile server memory together with a request counter for a rolling window of ten minutes and is then discarded. No record of these counters is written to disk.
Contact by email

If you write to us, your address and the content of your message are processed to answer you and, where a legal record is required, kept as correspondence. Nothing you send us is used for any other purpose.

blocks.x: Our balancing test for legitimate interests

Our interest is in running a site that loads, stays online, resists abuse and improves over time. The processing is limited to what a web server unavoidably sees plus aggregate statistics. We build no profiles, we do not track you across sites, and we enrich the data from no other source. Because the intrusion is minimal and no reasonable visitor would expect a website to run without it, we consider that your interests and fundamental rights do not override ours. You may object at any time on grounds relating to your particular situation under Article 21(1) GDPR.
Providing data is required neither by statute nor by contract. You are free to browse without using the assistants or contacting us, and nothing on the site is withheld if you do.

sections.title: The AI assistants
sections.summary: What happens to what you type, who processes it, and the limits you should assume.

blocks.x: You are interacting with an artificial intelligence system, not with a human. This is disclosed in the interface as required by Article 50 of the EU AI Act. Answers can be wrong. Never enter passwords, identity or residence document numbers, health information, financial details or another person's personal data into a chat.

The assistants run on a large language model operated by OpenAI as our processor. When you send a message, the following is transmitted: the text of your message, up to the last twenty turns of the current conversation for context, the assistant you selected, your interface language and the path of the page you were on. Nothing else is attached: no name, no account, no cookie and no analytics identifier.
